Licensees with established places of business shall post a photocopy of such license in a conspicuous place near the entrance of the licensee's place of business.
(L.L. 2021/126, 11/7/2021, eff. 11/7/2022)
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2021/126.
